tests.title: AC-19302-1: rcf verify run --package . --fbs FBS-001 --hand verifier at clean head H packs with npm pack into the scratch directory, exits 0 and prints "verify report: rcf/verify-reports/FBS-001/<head12>.json PASS 2/2"; target sha256 equals a separate npm pack of H, servedSha H, pack { command, exitCode 0 }

AC-19302-1 (TD-1): rcf verify run --package . --fbs FBS-001 --hand verifier on a package whose prepack prints to stdout before the npm JSON exits 0 with "verify report: rcf/verify-reports/FBS-001/<head12>.json PASS 2/2", target servedSha H and the sha256 of a separate pack of H, and pack.exitCode the exit code npm returned

AC-19302-1 (BH-1 b): rcf verify run --package . --fbs FBS-001 --hand verifier at clean head H with content git ignores but npm packs records servedSha H only on the bytes of a separate pack of H: exit 0, PASS 2/2, target.sha256 equals that pack, and the project is unchanged

AC-19302-2: rcf verify run --artefact fixture-cli-0.9.0.tgz --fbs FBS-001 --hand verifier at head H records target.version 0.9.0, the tarball sha256, servedSha null and no pack object, and an npm wrapper on PATH logs install and never pack

AC-19302-3: rcf verify run --artefact <tgz> --fbs FBS-001 --hand verifier --offline with an unresolvable dependency exits 1 with stderr "verify run: install failed (npm exit <n>); log rcf/verify-reports/FBS-001/<head12>/install.log", the log exists and no report JSON is written

AC-19302-3 (BH-2): rcf verify run --package . --fbs FBS-001 --hand verifier whose npm pack fails exits 1 with stderr "verify run: pack failed (npm exit <n>); log rcf/verify-reports/FBS-001/<head12>/pack.log", the log holds the npm output, no report JSON is written and nothing outside rcf/verify-reports/FBS-001/ changes

AC-19302-3 (TD-2): in a project whose .gitignore carries *.log, the log at the report install.logPath, the log of a failed install and the log of a failed pack are not ignored: git check-ignore does not match them and git status lists them, with no new path outside rcf/verify-reports/FBS-001/

AC-19302-4: rcf verify run --artefact <tgz> --fbs FBS-001 --hand verifier with --offline then without exits 0 both times; install.command carries --offline only on the first, install.registry offline then default; rcf build finalise never installs or reaches the network

AC-19302-5: rcf verify run --package . --fbs FBS-001 --hand verifier leaves no *.tgz, node_modules or package-lock.json change in git status, new paths only under rcf/verify-reports/FBS-001/, and a dirty tree outside rcf/verify-reports/ refuses exit 4 before packing

AC-19302-5 (BH-1 a): rcf verify run --package <dir> --fbs FBS-001 --hand verifier refuses exit 4 before packing when <dir> is outside the repository of the cwd (another repository, dirty or clean at another head, or a directory in no repository), and still packs a package directory inside the work tree of the repository

AC-19302-5 (BH-1 c): rcf verify run --package . --fbs FBS-001 --hand verifier on a package whose prepack writes into the tree it packs leaves the project unchanged (git status lists nothing outside rcf/verify-reports/FBS-001/) and records servedSha H on the bytes of a separate pack of H
